mapper.select: SELECT d.settle_date, SUM(d.qty) AS qty, SUM(d.total_fee) AS total_fee FROM tr_mi_recon_detail d JOIN tr_mi_recon_file f ON f.id = d.file_id AND f.status = '1' WHERE d.insur_type = #{insurType} AND d.settle_date BETWEEN TO_DATE(#{startDate}, 'yyyy-mm-dd') AND TO_DATE(#{endDate}, 'yyyy-mm-dd') GROUP BY d.settle_date ORDER BY d.settle_date
